verification_report.summary: The revised proof is correct relative to the expressly accepted internal and classical inputs. The kernel and duality arguments use the stated definitions consistently; the openness proof handles W_X={0}, and nonempty openness indeed implies that LG(X) spans W_X. For a modification, the general-position argument correctly distinguishes injectivity of H^1 restriction across an arbitrary analytic complement upstairs from the isomorphism across the codimension-at-least-two locus downstairs; extension from the common open set then proves that pi^*:H^1(X,R)->H^1(Y,R) is an isomorphism. Positive-current pullback/pushforward establishes pseudoeffectivity equivalence, while only bidegree-(1,1) Bott--Chern pullback injectivity is used. The common graph resolution yields the correctly oriented identification (q^*)^{-1}p^*, its Poincare dual identifies the Lee--Gauduchon cones, and injective restriction makes this independent of the resolution. No external-paper references occur beyond inputs explicitly accepted by the request.
